capabilities: Fit text boxes to their text and keep canvas layout tidy as a tree
Add child and sibling boxes with Tab and Enter
Turn text boxes into foldable callout flashcards
Run study mode that hides and reveals answers in arrow order
Color child boxes and arrows from their parent box
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition scheduler; it is a canvas mindmap tool whose study mode only hides and reveals answers on the canvas.
extras: Conflicts with Canvas Mindmap, Node Auto Resize, and Advanced Canvas's auto-resize option; the author warns to disable those and restart Obsidian. Uses Obsidian canvas internal APIs (no public canvas API), so features may break on Obsidian updates. Not reviewed by Obsidian. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+ and makes no network requests.
intentEvidence: A sibling of Flashcard Bank, which keeps flashcards in your notes instead.
problem: Obsidian's canvas has no mindmap workflow: text boxes don't resize to fit, adding connected boxes takes manual dragging and arrow drawing, and there is no built-in flashcard study mode.

relations.evidence: A sibling of Flashcard Bank, which keeps flashcards in your notes instead.

summary: Canvas mindmap plugin that fits boxes to their text, adds boxes with Tab and Enter, tidies layout, and can turn boxes into foldable flashcards with study mode.
